newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - August 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - August 5.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Elected representatives not eligible for pension.
Itinerary basically set for President Lee Teng-hui's trip to Central America.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Eleven industries to be incorporated under Labour Law in September.
Taiwan, China may resume dialogue in early 1998.
LIBERTY TIMES - Foreign ministry to withdraw representative office in Libya.
President Lee will not promise investments in Panama.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Chinese communists' probe into tax evasion of Taiwan projects in mainland should not affect companies in Taiwan.
President Lee to visit four countries in September trip.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Major banks mull rake hikes.
U.S. dollar continues to soar against mark.
